$comment: Home page is generated entirely from this file. `collections` are curated, ordered slug lists — edit those to change what is featured. `groups` are ordering hints for tags; a tag not listed in any group is auto-collected into "More Tags", so adding a new tag never requires editing HTML.

collections.label: Favorites
collections.description: Hand-picked. Edit the slug list here — nothing else needs touching.

groups.label: By Cuisine
groups.description: Regional lineage, including deliberate cross-cultural pivots.

groups.label: By Diet
groups.description: Dietary suitability as formulated. Check the matrix before substituting.

groups.label: By Technique
groups.description: The dominant process the sheet is built around.

groups.label: By Occasion
groups.description: How these fit into the week.

recipes.title: Basic Beet Pickle
recipes.blurb: A 1:1 rice wine vinegar quick pickle — deliberately herb-free so it stays structural next to stronger ferments.

recipes.title: Bicolor Shiso & Quinoa "Asian Dolmas"
recipes.blurb: Flash-blanched shiso leaves rolled around a sushi rice and quinoa filling, steamed then chilled so the starch locks the roll.

recipes.title: Braised Chickpeas with Fennel, Olives & Preserved Lemon
recipes.blurb: Seared fennel braised with chickpeas, briny olives, and preserved lemon rind until tender and citrus-forward.

recipes.title: Bubbies Clone Kosher Dill Pickles
recipes.blurb: A 3.5% salinity lacto-ferment with bay tannins to protect crunch, held anaerobic for 7–10 days then cold-cured.

recipes.title: Capunet Vegetariani alle Lenticchie
recipes.blurb: Piedmontese cabbage rolls filled with red lentils, potato, and stale bread, bound with egg and grated cheese, then baked.

recipes.title: Crispy Sheet Pan Black Bean Tacos
recipes.blurb: Mashed seasoned black beans folded into corn tortillas and crisped on an oiled sheet pan, flipped once for two-sided crunch.

recipes.title: Dual-Cheese Gougères
recipes.blurb: One choux base split into two equal masses — aged gouda with smoked paprika, extra-sharp cheddar with cracked pepper.

recipes.title: Edna Lewis and Scott Peacock's Lemon Chess Pie
recipes.blurb: A single-crust Southern chess pie — cornmeal and flour thickened, buttermilk and lemon forward, pulled while the center is still loose.

recipes.title: Five House Dressings
recipes.blurb: All-Purpose, Lemon-Dijon, Sesame-Soy, Classic Caesar, and Creamy Herby Green — one sheet, five emulsions.

recipes.title: Flax & Chia Dark Peanut Butter Bites
recipes.blurb: Flax and chia bind free oil in a peanut butter base; capped with 85% dark chocolate and flaky salt, set in the freezer.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie Chia Verrine
recipes.blurb: Chia-set lime and Greek yogurt cream layered over a toasted coconut graham crumble, assembled only at service.

recipes.title: Lule Kebab ala Father Vartan Joulfayan
recipes.blurb: Armenian ground-beef kebabs bound with breadcrumb and onion liquid, hand-rolled and grilled or oven-roasted.

recipes.title: Nutrient-Dense Marine Energy Bites
recipes.blurb: Date and apricot paste bound with nut butter, pulsed with oats, hemp hearts, and black sesame — built to hold shape in a cooler. Ten minutes, no baking.

recipes.title: Organic Rye & Hemp Seeded Loaf
recipes.blurb: 100% whole rye at 82% hydration with a seed soaker, high-frequency folds, and a 12–24 hour cold proof.

recipes.title: Oven-Crisped Oyster Mushroom
recipes.blurb: Kefir-dredged clusters packed in coarse-milled raw quinoa grit — micro-ventilation crisps them without a fryer.

recipes.title: Pasta With Rich and Hearty Mushroom Bolognese
recipes.blurb: Button and shiitake mushrooms fried to a chewy, meat-analogue texture, bound with roasted eggplant purée and layered glutamates.

recipes.title: Popovers with Prosciutto and Herbed Mascarpone
recipes.blurb: Kefir-acidulated batter into a screaming-hot popover pan, baked in two thermal stages and pierced immediately to de-steam.

recipes.title: Rye & Spelt Kefir Loaf (1.2 kg)
recipes.blurb: A 12-hour milk kefir levain driving a 650 g flour base at 80% hydration, scaled to a single large pan loaf.

recipes.title: Senegalese Black-Eyed Pea Salad (Saladou Niébé)
recipes.blurb: Cooked black-eyed peas cut with uniformly diced peppers and onion, dressed in lime and olive oil, then cured cold for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Summer Garbanzo Meal Prep
recipes.blurb: One kombu-cooked chickpea batch split into two formulations: a Thai larb-style salad and a pickle-brine pasta salad.

recipes.title: Sunflower-Tofu Veggie Burger
recipes.blurb: A reconstruction of the Nearly Normal's Sunburger — pressed tofu and toasted seed meal, egg-bound at a deliberately high ratio.

recipes.title: Tamarind Date Oat Energy Bars
recipes.blurb: Tamarind acid cut against date sweetness, with chia absorbing unbound water to stop the slab from weeping.

recipes.title: The Best Crispy Roast Potatoes Ever
recipes.blurb: Alkaline-boiled then roasted at 450°F — baking soda breaks down pectin to build the starchy slurry that becomes the crust.

recipes.title: Vegan Bún Bò Huế Broth
recipes.blurb: A clarified sweet-vegetable and shiitake extraction, finished with a crimson annatto-lemongrass sate infusion.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Crying Tiger (Sua Rong Hai)
recipes.blurb: King oyster mushroom planks dry-seared under weight, lacquered with a palm sugar glaze, and flashed under the broiler. Served with nam jim jaew.
